source.verticalReference: Provider elevations in metres; 3DEP CONUS products normally use NAVD88. Per-cell vertical datum and independent map registration are not verified.
source.acquisition: Mixed provider DEM sources; retrieval and catalog date attributes are not verified per-cell flight dates.

method.nativeResolution: mixed; output spacing is not native resolution
limitations: Provider multi-resolution bare-earth mosaic; not uniformly native 1 m LiDAR.
Each column displays a provider-resampled pixel centre value over its footprint; no subpixel terrain is measured.
Web Mercator cell spacing is projected map distance; physical ground spacing varies with latitude.
Catalog pixel resolutions may use different source units; signed raw attributes are not the output cell size.
Catalog date attributes retain provider encoding and do not prove survey flight dates.
The display closure pedestal is visual only; missing cells remain missing and scientific accuracy is pending.
